activities.summary: Sourced via Praxis Rock's Saudi family-office directory as the largest and most prominent named single-family office in the Kingdom. Disqualified: purely proprietary capital, no third-party money, no named regulator, no public contact route. Recorded explicitly so this obvious name is not re-researched in a future pass; the general pattern (large Saudi merchant-family conglomerates are invisible/proprietary unless they spin out a CMA-licensed arm) applies to the rest of Praxis Rock's 22-firm list too - not individually re-added here to avoid padding the CRM with near-identical disqualifications.

description: Saudi Arabia's largest and oldest disclosed single-family office (est. 1947, Riyadh), USD 10bn+ AUM across listed equities, private equity, debt and real estate globally. The most prominent name in Praxis Rock's 22-firm Saudi family-office directory.

fit.disqualified_reason: Purely proprietary single-family capital (USD 10bn+, one family, since 1947); no third-party money, no named regulator, no compliance driver, and no public route in. Recorded so we do not re-research the most obvious name in every Saudi family-office list. Re-open only if it spins out a CMA-regulated arm managing external money (the pattern seen at SEDCO Holding->SEDCO Capital and Come->Come Asset Management).
fit.reasoning: Fit 30/60: priority segment family_office (20) + priority market KSA (15) - wait, recompute: 20+15=35, then multi-asset yes (10) = 45, but 0 for third-party money (purely proprietary global family capital, explicitly disclosed as USD 10bn+ of its own wealth) and 0 for named regulator (none found - a private investment company, not a CMA-licensed entity). Fit subtotal 45/60 on the table, but disqualified per icp.md's explicit criterion: 'purely proprietary trading with no third-party money and no compliance driver' - Olayan's scale does not change that it is a private, unregulated holding vehicle for one family, structurally the clearest case of the disqualify list in the entire Saudi directory. Trigger 0/25, access 0/15 (no named contact found; a company this private and long-established is very unlikely to grant a route in without a warm referral). Recorded at 12 (not 0) only to reflect its real multi-asset scale if circumstances ever change (e.g. it opens to external mandates or spins out a CMA-licensed arm, as SEDCO and Al Rajhi branches have done).
